description: This file contains unit tests for various grain placement strategies in an Orleans-based application, including default, random, prefer local, and stateless worker placements.

classes.name: GrainPlacementTests
classes.description: A class containing tests for different grain placement strategies in Orleans, verifying correct behavior and placement.

methods.name: VerifyDefaultPlacement
methods.description: Tests that the default grain placement strategy returns the expected placement type.

methods.name: RandomlyPlacedGrainShouldPlaceActivationsRandomly
methods.description: Verifies that grains are randomly placed across silos, aiming for a non-uniform distribution.

methods.name: PreferLocalPlacedGrainShouldPlaceActivationsLocally_TwoHops
methods.description: Checks that grains configured for local placement are indeed colocated with their requesting grains.

methods.name: CollectActivationIds
methods.description: Collects a sample of activation IDs from a given grain.

methods.name: ActivationCount
methods.description: Counts the number of distinct activations for a specific grain.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerShouldCreateSpecifiedActivationCount
methods.description: Ensures that stateless worker grains create an activation count within configured limits.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerGrainShouldCreateActivationsOnLocalSilo
methods.description: Verifies that stateless worker grains are instantiated on the local silo as expected.
